history.body: Hi, saw the Pearl Residences ad. We’re renting a small place now and looking for our first home. The 3 bedrooms caught my eye—would that suit a couple with a young child?

It could be a practical fit. The Phase 1 homes have 3 bedrooms and 2 bathrooms across 900 sq. ft., so you could have your own room, a room for your child, and keep the third room flexible as your family’s needs change. Seeing the layout in person would help you judge whether the room sizes work for you—would you and your partner like to arrange a viewing?

That layout sounds like it could work for us, especially having a room for our child. Before we arrange a viewing, what’s the price range for the 3-bedroom homes? Around RM302k might be manageable for us.

For an eligible Block 1B podium-blocked unit on Levels 1–4, the listed RM328k base less the 8% package works out to about RM301,760 (roughly RM302k), before any unit-specific car-park or add-on items. That’s close to the budget you mentioned. A viewing would let you and your partner see whether the 900 sq. ft. three-bedroom layout feels comfortable for your family—would you like to arrange one?
That’s close to what we had in mind, and seeing the layout would help us judge the fit. Yes, my partner and I would be interested in arranging a viewing. What days are available?

Great—I'll pass this to a salesperson to confirm the available days and coordinate a viewing for you and your partner. Seeing the layout should help you judge the room sizes and overall fit for your family. The visit isn’t booked until they confirm the arrangements.
